सही उत्तर है **उनका स्वामित्व सार्वजनिक और निजी क्षेत्रों के पास संयुक्त रूप से होता है।**

मुख्य बिंदु

	**संयुक्त क्षेत्र के उद्योग** ऐसे उद्यम हैं जहाँ स्वामित्व **सरकार (सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र)** और **निजी संस्थाओं** के बीच साझा किया जाता है।
	संयुक्त क्षेत्र के उद्योगों की अवधारणा को सार्वजनिक और निजी दोनों क्षेत्रों की ताकत को मिलाने के लिए पेश किया गया था, जैसे कि **सरकारी नियंत्रण** और **निजी क्षेत्र की दक्षता।**
	इन उद्योगों का उद्देश्य आर्थिक विकास को बढ़ावा देना, रोजगार सृजित करना और **अविकसित क्षेत्रों** में उद्योगों का विकास करना है।
	संयुक्त क्षेत्र के उद्योगों के उदाहरणों में **ऑयल इंडिया लिमिटेड** जैसी कंपनियां शामिल हैं, जहाँ सरकार और निजी हितधारक दोनों स्वामित्व और प्रबंधन जिम्मेदारियों को साझा करते हैं।
	ये उद्योग बड़े पैमाने पर निजी एकाधिकार और पूर्ण राज्य नियंत्रण के बीच **अंतर को पाटने** में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाते हैं।

**अतिरिक्त जानकारी**

	**आर्थिक गतिविधि द्वारा (5-क्षेत्र मॉडल)**

	
		प्राथमिक: प्राकृतिक संसाधनों का निष्कर्षण या कटाई (जैसे, कृषि, मछली पकड़ना, खनन, वानिकी)।
		द्वितीयक: कच्चे माल को तैयार उत्पादों में बदलना (जैसे, विनिर्माण, निर्माण, खाद्य प्रसंस्करण)।
		तृतीयक: अमूर्त सेवाएं प्रदान करना (जैसे, खुदरा, स्वास्थ्य सेवा, शिक्षा, परिवहन, बैंकिंग)।
		चतुर्थक: सूचना, ज्ञान और अनुसंधान पर ध्यान केंद्रित करना (जैसे, आईटी, अनुसंधान एवं विकास, परामर्श)।
		पंचक: उच्च-स्तरीय निर्णय लेने और शीर्ष अधिकारियों को शामिल करना (जैसे, सरकार, वरिष्ठ प्रबंधन, वैज्ञानिक अनुसंधान)।

questions.questionText: Which authority decides whether a Bill is a Money Bill?
questions.questionTextHi: कौन-सा प्राधिकारी यह निर्णय लेता है कि कोई विधेयक धन विधेयक है या नहीं?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Speaker of Lok Sabha**.

Key Points

The **Speaker of Lok Sabha** has the exclusive authority to decide whether a Bill is a Money Bill as per **Article 110** of the Indian Constitution.
A Money Bill is primarily concerned with matters such as taxation, borrowing by the government, expenditure, and financial obligations of the state.
The Speaker’s decision regarding the classification of a Bill as a Money Bill is considered final and cannot be challenged in any court.
The **Money Bill** can only be introduced in the Lok Sabha on the recommendation of the President, but its categorization rests with the Speaker.
The Rajya Sabha can only make recommendations on a Money Bill, and these recommendations may or may not be accepted by the Lok Sabha.

**Additional Information**

**Finance Minister**

The Finance Minister is responsible for presenting the Union Budget and managing the financial affairs of the country.
However, the Finance Minister does not have the authority to decide whether a Bill is a Money Bill.
The Finance Minister may propose the Bill, but its classification as a Money Bill is decided solely by the Speaker of Lok Sabha.

**President**

The President of India has the power to recommend the introduction of a Money Bill in the Lok Sabha.
Before the introduction of a Money Bill, the recommendation of the President is mandatory under Article 110.
However, the President does not determine whether a Bill qualifies as a Money Bill; this decision is made by the Speaker of Lok Sabha.

**Comptroller & Auditor General (CAG)**

The Comptroller & Auditor General (CAG) is responsible for auditing the accounts of the central and state governments and ensuring financial accountability.
The CAG does not play any role in determining the classification of a Bill as a Money Bill.
The CAG’s functions are limited to auditing and reporting financial irregularities, not legislative procedures.

**Important Points**

**Money Bill**

A Money Bill is defined under Article 110 of the Indian Constitution. It deals exclusively with matters specified in Article 110(1), such as taxation, public expenditure, and borrowing.
It can only be introduced in Lok Sabha and requires the President's recommendation before introduction.
The Rajya Sabha cannot amend or reject a Money Bill; it can only make recommendations, which the Lok Sabha may or may not accept.
The final authority to determine whether a Bill is a Money Bill rests with the Speaker of Lok Sabha.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **लोकसभा अध्यक्ष** है।

मुख्य बिंदु

	**लोकसभा अध्यक्ष** के पास भारतीय संविधान के **अनुच्छेद 110** के अनुसार यह तय करने का विशेष अधिकार है कि कोई विधेयक धन विधेयक है या नहीं।
	धन विधेयक मुख्य रूप से कराधान, सरकार द्वारा उधार, व्यय और राज्य के वित्तीय दायित्वों जैसे मामलों से संबंधित है।
	किसी विधेयक को धन विधेयक के रूप में वर्गीकृत करने के संबंध में अध्यक्ष का निर्णय अंतिम माना जाता है और इसे किसी भी न्यायालय में चुनौती नहीं दी जा सकती है।
	**धन विधेयक** को केवल राष्ट्रपति की सिफारिश पर लोकसभा में पेश किया जा सकता है, लेकिन इसका वर्गीकरण अध्यक्ष के पास होता है।
	राज्यसभा केवल धन विधेयक पर सिफारिशें कर सकती है, और इन सिफारिशों को लोकसभा द्वारा स्वीकार किया जा सकता है या नहीं भी किया जा सकता है।

**अतिरिक्त जानकारी**

	**वित्त मंत्री**

	
		वित्त मंत्री केंद्रीय बजट पेश करने और देश के वित्तीय मामलों के प्रबंधन के लिए जिम्मेदार होता है।
		हालांकि, वित्त मंत्री के पास यह तय करने का अधिकार नहीं है कि कोई विधेयक धन विधेयक है या नहीं।
		वित्त मंत्री विधेयक का प्रस्ताव कर सकते हैं, लेकिन इसे धन विधेयक के रूप में वर्गीकृत करने का निर्णय पूरी तरह से लोकसभा अध्यक्ष द्वारा लिया जाता है।
	
	
	**राष्ट्रपति**
	
		भारत के राष्ट्रपति के पास लोकसभा में धन विधेयक पेश करने की सिफारिश करने की शक्ति है।
		धन विधेयक पेश करने से पहले, अनुच्छेद 110 के तहत राष्ट्रपति की सिफारिश अनिवार्य है।
		हालांकि, राष्ट्रपति यह निर्धारित नहीं करते हैं कि कोई विधेयक धन विधेयक के रूप में योग्य है या नहीं; यह निर्णय लोकसभा अध्यक्ष द्वारा लिया जाता है।
	
	
	**नियंत्रक एवं महालेखा परीक्षक (CAG)**
	
		नियंत्रक एवं महालेखा परीक्षक (CAG) केंद्र और राज्य सरकारों के खातों का ऑडिट करने और वित्तीय जवाबदेही सुनिश्चित करने के लिए जिम्मेदार है।
		CAG की भूमिका किसी विधेयक को धन विधेयक के रूप में वर्गीकृत करने के निर्धारण में नहीं होती है।
		CAG के कार्य वित्तीय अनियमितताओं का ऑडिट और रिपोर्ट करने तक सीमित हैं, न कि विधायी प्रक्रियाओं तक।
	
	

**महत्वपूर्ण बिंदु**

	**धन विधेयक**

	
		धन विधेयक को भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 110 के तहत परिभाषित किया गया है। यह विशेष रूप से अनुच्छेद 110(1) में निर्दिष्ट मामलों से संबंधित है, जैसे कि कराधान, सार्वजनिक व्यय और उधार।
		इसे केवल लोकसभा में पेश किया जा सकता है और पेश करने से पहले राष्ट्रपति की सिफारिश की आवश्यकता होती है।
		राज्यसभा धन विधेयक में संशोधन या अस्वीकार नहीं कर सकती है; यह केवल सिफारिशें कर सकती है, जिसे लोकसभा स्वीकार कर सकती है या नहीं भी कर सकती है।
		यह निर्धारित करने का अंतिम अधिकार कि कोई विधेयक धन विधेयक है या नहीं, लोकसभा अध्यक्ष के पास होता है।

questions.questionText: What astronomical observation is most severely hampered by increasing levels of urban light pollution?
questions.questionTextHi: शहरी प्रकाश प्रदूषण के बढ़ते स्तर के कारण कौन-सा खगोलीय अवलोकन सबसे अधिक बाधित हो रहा है?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Deep-sky objects**.

Key Points

Deep-sky objects refer to astronomical entities such as galaxies, nebulae, star clusters, and distant celestial objects that are faint and require dark skies for observation.
Urban light pollution significantly hampers the visibility of deep-sky objects by increasing the sky brightness, reducing contrast, and obscuring faint objects.
Light pollution from artificial sources, such as streetlights and buildings, scatters in the atmosphere, overwhelming the faint light emitted by deep-sky objects.
Observing deep-sky objects typically requires remote locations or observatories situated far from urban areas to minimize the effects of light pollution.
Efforts to mitigate light pollution, including the use of shielded lighting and adherence to dark-sky standards, are crucial for preserving the visibility of deep-sky objects.

**Additional Information**

**Sunspots**

Sunspots are dark, cooler areas on the Sun's surface caused by magnetic activity that inhibits convection.
Observing sunspots does not typically require dark skies, as they can be seen using solar filters or telescopes during the daytime.
Urban light pollution does not significantly affect the observation of sunspots, as they are observed against the bright background of the Sun.

**Planetary Transit**

Planetary transit occurs when a planet passes in front of its host star, causing a temporary dip in the star's brightness.
These events are usually studied using telescopes equipped with photometers or spectrometers, and they are not as affected by light pollution as deep-sky objects.
However, precise measurements of brightness changes may require optimal conditions, which can be influenced by urban light pollution.

**Lunar Phases**

Lunar phases refer to the appearance of the Moon as it orbits Earth, changing its illuminated portion visible from Earth.
Light pollution has minimal impact on observing lunar phases because the Moon is bright enough to be visible even in urban environments.
Lunar observation is often used as an introductory activity for amateur astronomers due to its ease of visibility.

**Light Pollution and Astronomy**

Light pollution refers to the excessive and misdirected artificial light that disrupts natural darkness, impacting astronomical observations.
It reduces the visibility of faint celestial objects and interferes with professional and amateur astronomy.
Organizations like the International Dark-Sky Association (IDA) advocate for measures to reduce light pollution through responsible lighting practices.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **डीप-स्काई ऑब्जेक्ट्स** है।

मुख्य बिंदु

	डीप-स्काई ऑब्जेक्ट्स से तात्पर्य खगोलीय संस्थाओं जैसे आकाशगंगाओं, नीहारिकाओं, स्टार क्लस्टर्स और दूर के आकाशीय पिंडों से है जो धुंधले होते हैं और अवलोकन के लिए अंधेरे आसमान की आवश्यकता होती है।
	शहरी प्रकाश प्रदूषण आकाश की चमक को बढ़ाकर, कंट्रास्ट को कम करके और धुंधली वस्तुओं को अस्पष्ट करके डीप-स्काई ऑब्जेक्ट्स की दृश्यता को महत्वपूर्ण रूप से बाधित करता है।
	कृत्रिम स्रोतों, जैसे स्ट्रीटलाइट्स और इमारतों से प्रकाश प्रदूषण, वातावरण में बिखर जाता है, जिससे डीप-स्काई ऑब्जेक्ट्स द्वारा उत्सर्जित धुंधला प्रकाश अभिभूत हो जाता है।
	डीप-स्काई ऑब्जेक्ट्स को देखने के लिए आमतौर पर शहरी क्षेत्रों से दूर स्थित दूरस्थ स्थानों या वेधशालाओं की आवश्यकता होती है ताकि प्रकाश प्रदूषण के प्रभावों को कम किया जा सके।
	प्रकाश प्रदूषण को कम करने के प्रयासों, जिसमें परिरक्षित प्रकाश व्यवस्था का उपयोग और अंधेरे-आकाश मानकों का पालन शामिल है, डीप-स्काई ऑब्जेक्ट्स की दृश्यता को संरक्षित करने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण हैं।

**अतिरिक्त जानकारी**

	**सनस्पॉट**

	
		सनस्पॉट सूर्य की सतह पर गहरे, ठंडे क्षेत्र होते हैं जो चुंबकीय गतिविधि के कारण होते हैं जो संवहन को रोकता है।
		सनस्पॉट को देखने के लिए आमतौर पर अंधेरे आसमान की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है, क्योंकि उन्हें दिन के दौरान सौर फिल्टर या दूरबीनों का उपयोग करके देखा जा सकता है।
		शहरी प्रकाश प्रदूषण सनस्पॉट के अवलोकन को महत्वपूर्ण रूप से प्रभावित नहीं करता है, क्योंकि उन्हें सूर्य की उज्ज्वल पृष्ठभूमि के खिलाफ देखा जाता है।
	
	
	**ग्रहों का पारगमन**
	
		ग्रहों का पारगमन तब होता है जब कोई ग्रह अपने मेजबान तारे के सामने से गुजरता है, जिससे तारे की चमक में अस्थायी गिरावट आती है।
		इन घटनाओं का अध्ययन आमतौर पर फोटोमीटर या स्पेक्ट्रोमीटर से लैस दूरबीनों का उपयोग करके किया जाता है, और वे डीप-स्काई ऑब्जेक्ट्स की तरह प्रकाश प्रदूषण से प्रभावित नहीं होते हैं।
		हालांकि, चमक में बदलाव के सटीक माप के लिए इष्टतम परिस्थितियों की आवश्यकता हो सकती है, जो शहरी प्रकाश प्रदूषण से प्रभावित हो सकती हैं।
	
	
	**चंद्र चरण**
	
		चंद्र चरण पृथ्वी की परिक्रमा करते समय चंद्रमा की उपस्थिति को संदर्भित करते हैं, जो पृथ्वी से दिखाई देने वाले इसके प्रकाशित हिस्से को बदलते हैं।
		चंद्र चरणों को देखने पर प्रकाश प्रदूषण का न्यूनतम प्रभाव पड़ता है क्योंकि चंद्रमा शहरी वातावरण में भी दिखाई देने के लिए पर्याप्त उज्ज्वल है।
		चंद्र अवलोकन का उपयोग अक्सर शौकिया खगोलविदों के लिए एक परिचयात्मक गतिविधि के रूप में किया जाता है क्योंकि इसकी दृश्यता आसान होती है।
	
	
	**प्रकाश प्रदूषण और खगोल विज्ञान**
	
		प्रकाश प्रदूषण अत्यधिक और गलत निर्देशित कृत्रिम प्रकाश को संदर्भित करता है जो प्राकृतिक अंधेरे को बाधित करता है, जिससे खगोलीय अवलोकन प्रभावित होते हैं।
		यह धुंधली आकाशीय वस्तुओं की दृश्यता को कम करता है और पेशेवर और शौकिया खगोल विज्ञान में हस्तक्षेप करता है।
		इंटरनेशनल डार्क-स्काई एसोसिएशन (आईडीए) जैसे संगठन जिम्मेदार प्रकाश व्यवस्था प्रथाओं के माध्यम से प्रकाश प्रदूषण को कम करने के उपायों की वकालत करते हैं।

questions.questionText: Evaluate the expression: \((\frac{1}{4} \div \frac{1}{2}) \div (\frac{1}{15} + 1 - \frac{9}{10}) \)
questions.questionTextHi: व्यंजक का मान ज्ञात कीजिए: \((\frac{1}{4} \div \frac{1}{2}) \div (\frac{1}{15} + 1 - \frac{9}{10})\)
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick

First bracket: (1/4 ÷ 1/2) = 1/4 × 2 = 1/2

Second bracket: (1/15 + 1 − 9/10) = 2/30 + 30/30 − 27/30 = 5/30 = 1/6

Combine results: 1/2 ÷ 1/6 = 1/2 × 6 = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Expression: (1/4 ÷ 1/2) ÷ (1/15 + 1 − 9/10)

**Formula Used:**

BODMAS Rule: Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Step 1: Solve the first bracket (1/4 ÷ 1/2)

⇒ 1/4 ÷ 1/2 = 1/4 × 2/1 = 2/4 = 1/2

⇒ Step 2: Solve the second bracket (1/15 + 1 − 9/10)

⇒ Find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of the denominators 15 and 10, which is 30.

⇒ 1/15 = 2/30

⇒ 1 = 30/30

⇒ 9/10 = 27/30

⇒ (2/30 + 30/30 − 27/30) = (2 + 30 − 27) / 30 = 5/30 = 1/6

⇒ Step 3: Divide the result of the first bracket by the result of the second bracket

⇒ 1/2 ÷ 1/6 = 1/2 × 6/1

⇒ 6 / 2 = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

**Additional Information**

BODMAS Rule

It dictates the order of operations: Brackets first, then Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and finally Subtraction.

Fraction Division

To divide by a fraction, multiply by its reciprocal: (a/b) ÷ (c/d) = (a/b) × (d/c).

Fraction Addition & Subtraction

Always find the LCM of the denominators to make them identical before adding or subtracting the numerators directly.

questions.questionText: The number of red, blue, and green marbles in a bag is in the ratio 3 : 4 : 6. If 20 red marbles, 15 blue marbles, and an unknown number of green marbles are added to the bag, the ratio of red, blue, and green marbles becomes 4 : 5 : 7. Determine the number of green marbles added.
questions.questionTextHi: एक थैले में लाल, नीले और हरे कंचों की संख्या का अनुपात 3 : 4 : 6 है। यदि थैले में 20 लाल कंचे, 15 नीले कंचे और अज्ञात संख्या में हरे कंचे डाले जाएँ तो लाल, नीले और हरे कंचों का अनुपात 4 : 5 : 7 हो जाता है। डाले गए हरे कंचों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Initial R : B = 3 : 4 and final R : B = 4 : 5. Quantities added are +20 and +15.

Using cross-multiplication: 1 unit = (20 × 5 − 15 × 4) / (4 × 4 − 3 × 5) = (100 − 60) / 1 = 40.

Initial green marbles = 6 units = 6 × 40 = 240. New red marbles = (3 × 40) + 20 = 140.

New red (140) equals 4 parts in final ratio. Thus, 1 final part = 140 ÷ 4 = 35.

New green = 7 final parts = 7 × 35 = 245. Green marbles added = 245 − 240 = 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Initial ratio of red, blue, and green marbles = 3 : 4 : 6

Red marbles added = 20, Blue marbles added = 15

Final ratio of red, blue, and green marbles = 4 : 5 : 7

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the initial number of red, blue, and green marbles be 3y, 4y, and 6y respectively.

⇒ After adding the marbles, new number of red marbles = 3y + 20

questions.questionText: A invests ₹25,000 for 12 months, B invests ₹50,000 for 6 months. What is A's share of ₹30,000 profit?
questions.questionTextHi: A ने 12 माह के लिए ₹25,000 का निवेश किया है, B ने 6 माह के लिए ₹50,000 का निवेश किया है। ₹30,000 के लाभ में A का भाग क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Profit ratio = (Capital of A × Time of A) : (Capital of B × Time of B)

Profit ratio = (25000 × 12) : (50000 × 6) = 300000 : 300000 = 1 : 1

Total profit ratio parts = 1 + 1 = 2 parts.

2 parts = ₹30,000 ⇒ 1 part = ₹15,000.

A's share is 1 part = ₹15,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15,000.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

A's Investment = ₹25,000, Time = 12 months

B's Investment = ₹50,000, Time = 6 months

Total Profit = ₹30,000

**Formula Used:**

Profit Ratio = (C1 × T1) : (C2 × T2)

Partner A
Cap: ₹25,000
Time: 12 months
Weight: 3,00,000

Partner B
Cap: ₹50,000
Time: 6 months
Weight: 3,00,000

Profit Ratio (A : B) = 1 : 1

**Calculations:**

⇒ Profit ratio of A and B = (25000 × 12) : (50000 × 6)

⇒ Profit ratio = 300000 : 300000 = 1 : 1

⇒ Sum of ratio parts = 1 + 1 = 2

⇒ A's share = (1 ÷ 2) × Total Profit

⇒ A's share = (1 ÷ 2) × 30000

⇒ A's share = 15000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15,000.**

**Additional Information**

Simple Partnership

When all partners invest their capital for the same duration of time, the profit is distributed strictly in the ratio of their original investments.

Compound Partnership

When partners invest for different periods, the equivalent capital for each is calculated as Investment × Time. Profit is distributed in the ratio of these final products.

Working Partner vs Sleeping Partner

A working partner actively manages the business and is typically paid a fixed salary or a certain profit percentage before the rest of the profit is divided among all active and sleeping partners.

questions.questionText: A and B start a business with capitals in the ratio 5:3. After 6 months, A withdraws ₹10,000 and B doubles his investment. If the initial investment of A was ₹50,000, and the total profit after 1 year is ₹84,000, find the profit share of A.
questions.questionTextHi: A और B, 5:3 के अनुपात में पूँजी के साथ एक व्यवसाय प्रारंभ करते हैं। 6 माह बाद, A, ₹10,000 निकाल लेता है और B अपना निवेश दोगुना कर देता है। यदि A का प्रारंभिक निवेश ₹50,000 था, और 1 वर्ष के बाद कुल लाभ ₹84,000 है, तो A का लाभ भाग ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Initial capital ratio = 5 : 3. Since A's capital = ₹50,000, B's = ₹30,000.

Equivalent capital of A = (50k × 6) + (40k × 6) = 540k

Equivalent capital of B = (30k × 6) + (60k × 6) = 540k

Profit ratio = 540k : 540k = 1 : 1

Profit share of A = (1 ÷ 2) × ₹84,000 = ₹42,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹42,000.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Initial capital ratio of A : B = 5 : 3

Initial capital of A = ₹50,000

**Formula Used:**

Total Equivalent Capitals: A = ₹5,40,000 | B = ₹5,40,000

**Calculations:**

⇒ Initial capital of A = 5 units = ₹50,000

⇒ 1 unit = ₹50,000 ÷ 5 = ₹10,000

⇒ Initial capital of B = 3 units = 3 × ₹10,000 = ₹30,000

⇒ After 6 months, A withdraws ₹10,000, so new capital = ₹50,000 − ₹10,000 = ₹40,000

⇒ After 6 months, B doubles his investment, so new capital = ₹30,000 × 2 = ₹60,000

⇒ Equivalent capital of A = (₹50,000 × 6) + (₹40,000 × 6) = ₹3,00,000 + ₹2,40,000 = ₹5,40,000

⇒ Equivalent capital of B = (₹30,000 × 6) + (₹60,000 × 6) = ₹1,80,000 + ₹3,60,000 = ₹5,40,000

⇒ Ratio of profit share = 5,40,000 : 5,40,000 = 1 : 1

⇒ Sum of profit ratios = 1 + 1 = 2 units

⇒ A's profit share = (1 ÷ 2) × ₹84,000 = ₹42,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹42,000.**

**Additional Information**

Compound Partnership

When capitals are invested for unequal time periods, profits are shared in the ratio of the product of capital and time, known as equivalent capital.

Simple Partnership

When partners invest their capitals for the exact same period, the profit is purely distributed in the respective ratio of their original investments.

Working vs Sleeping Partner

A working active partner manages the business and usually receives a salary or fixed percentage of profit. A sleeping partner only provides funds and gets a share solely based on capital and time ratio.

questions.questionText: What is the average of all three-digit numbers divisible by 23?
questions.questionTextHi: 23 से विभाज्य सभी तीन अंकीय संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
The sequence of multiples forms an Arithmetic Progression (A.P.).

Average of an A.P. = (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2

First 3-digit multiple of 23 = 115

Last 3-digit multiple of 23 = 989

Average = (115 + 989) ÷ 2 = 552

**∴ The correct answer is 552.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

We need to find the average of all three-digit numbers divisible by 23.

**Formula Used:**

For an Arithmetic Progression (A.P.), Average = (a + l) ÷ 2

Where 'a' is the first term and 'l' is the last term.

115
First Term

989
Last Term

552
Average (Midpoint)

Average = (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Smallest three-digit number = 100

⇒ 100 ÷ 23 = 4 with a remainder of 8

⇒ First 3-digit multiple of 23 (a) = 23 × 5 = 115

⇒ Largest three-digit number = 999

⇒ 999 ÷ 23 = 43 with a remainder of 10

⇒ Last 3-digit multiple of 23 (l) = 23 × 43 = 989

⇒ The sequence of numbers forms an A.P.: 115, 138, 161, ..., 989

⇒ Average of the A.P. = (115 + 989) ÷ 2

⇒ Average = 1104 ÷ 2 = 552

**∴ The correct answer is 552.**

**Additional Information**

Arithmetic Progression (A.P.)

A sequence of numbers where the difference between consecutive terms is constant. General form: a, a+d, a+2d, ...

Average of an A.P.

The average (mean) of an A.P. is strictly equal to the average of its first and last terms: Average = (a + l) ÷ 2.

Number of Terms in an A.P.

The total number of terms (n) in a finite arithmetic sequence can be calculated using the formula: n = [(l − a) ÷ d] + 1.

⇒ 23 का पहला 3-अंकीय गुणज (a) = 23 × 5 = 115

⇒ सबसे बड़ी तीन-अंकीय संख्या = 999

⇒ 999 ÷ 23 = 43 और शेष 10

⇒ 23 का अंतिम 3-अंकीय गुणज (l) = 23 × 43 = 989

⇒ संख्याओं का अनुक्रम एक समांतर श्रेणी बनाता है: 115, 138, 161, ..., 989

⇒ समांतर श्रेणी का औसत = (115 + 989) ÷ 2

⇒ औसत = 1104 ÷ 2 = 552

**∴ सही उत्तर 552 है।**

**Additional Information**

Arithmetic Progression (A.P.)

संख्याओं का एक अनुक्रम जहाँ क्रमागत पदों के बीच का अंतर स्थिर होता है। सामान्य रूप: a, a+d, a+2d, ...

Average of an A.P.

एक A.P. का औसत (माध्य) इसके पहले और अंतिम पदों के औसत के बराबर होता है: औसत = (a + l) ÷ 2।

Number of Terms in an A.P.

एक परिमित समांतर अनुक्रम में पदों की कुल संख्या (n) सूत्र का उपयोग करके गणना की जा सकती है: n = [(l − a) ÷ d] + 1।

questions.questionText: Two containers of the same volume are 40% and 50% full of water, respectively. They are then filled completely with milk. If the contents of both containers are mixed in a larger vessel, what is the percentage of milk in the final mixture?
questions.questionTextHi: समान आयतन वाले दो पात्र क्रमशः 40% और 50% पानी से भरे हैं। फिर उन्हें दूध से पूरी तरह भर दिया जाता है। यदि दोनों पात्रों की सामग्री को एक बड़े पात्र में मिला दिया जाए, तो अंतिम मिश्रण में दूध का प्रतिशत क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Let the volume of each container be 100 units.

Container 1 has 40 units water ⇒ Milk filled = 100 − 40 = 60 units.

Container 2 has 50 units water ⇒ Milk filled = 100 − 50 = 50 units.

Total milk in mixture = 60 + 50 = 110 units; Total volume = 100 + 100 = 200 units.

Fraction of milk in final mixture = 110 ÷ 200 = 0.55.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.55 (or 55%).**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

⇒ Volume of Container 1 = Volume of Container 2

⇒ Water in Container 1 = 40%

⇒ Water in Container 2 = 50%

⇒ Remaining capacity of both containers is completely filled with milk.

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Fraction of Milk = (Total Volume of Milk) ÷ (Total Volume of Mixture)

Milk: 60
Water: 40
Vol: 100

+

Milk: 50
Water: 50
Vol: 100

Total Milk: 110
(55%)
Total Water: 90
(45%)
Final Vol: 200

Mixture Process

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the capacity of each container be 100 units.

⇒ Volume of water in Container 1 = 40% of 100 = 40 units

⇒ Volume of milk added in Container 1 = 100 − 40 = 60 units

⇒ Volume of water in Container 2 = 50% of 100 = 50 units

⇒ Volume of milk added in Container 2 = 100 − 50 = 50 units

⇒ Total volume of milk in final mixture = 60 + 50 = 110 units

⇒ Total volume of the final mixture = 100 + 100 = 200 units

⇒ Fraction of milk in final mixture = 110 ÷ 200

⇒ Fraction = 11 ÷ 20 = 0.55

**∴ The correct answer is 0.55 (or 55%).**

**Additional Information**

Mixtures & Alligations

When mixing two quantities, the ratio of their volumes directly determines the weighted average of any concentration present in them.

Weighted Average Formula

Final Concentration = (C1V1 + C2V2) ÷ (V1 + V2), where C is concentration and V is volume.

Successive Replacement

If a fraction of a mixture is removed and replaced with a pure component iteratively, the remaining original component is calculated as Final = Initial × (1 − Removed/Total)n.
questions.explanationHi:
Shortcut Trick
मान लीजिए कि प्रत्येक कंटेनर का आयतन 100 इकाइयाँ है।

कंटेनर 1 में 40 इकाई पानी है ⇒ भरा हुआ दूध = 100 − 40 = 60 इकाइयाँ।

कंटेनर 2 में 50 इकाई पानी है ⇒ भरा हुआ दूध = 100 − 50 = 50 इकाइयाँ।

मिश्रण में कुल दूध = 60 + 50 = 110 इकाइयाँ; कुल आयतन = 100 + 100 = 200 इकाइयाँ।

अंतिम मिश्रण में दूध का अंश = 110 ÷ 200 = 0.55।

**∴ सही उत्तर 0.55 (या 55%) है।**

**Alternate Method**

**दिया गया है:**

⇒ कंटेनर 1 का आयतन = कंटेनर 2 का आयतन

⇒ कंटेनर 1 में पानी = 40%

⇒ कंटेनर 2 में पानी = 50%

⇒ दोनों कंटेनरों की शेष क्षमता पूरी तरह से दूध से भरी है।

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

⇒ दूध का अंश = (दूध का कुल आयतन) ÷ (मिश्रण का कुल आयतन)

  
  
  
  दूध: 60

  (55%)
  कुल पानी: 90
  (45%)
  अंतिम आयतन: 200
  
  मिश्रण प्रक्रिया

**गणनाएँ:**

⇒ मान लीजिए प्रत्येक कंटेनर की क्षमता 100 इकाइयाँ है।

⇒ कंटेनर 1 में पानी का आयतन = 100 का 40% = 40 इकाइयाँ

⇒ कंटेनर 1 में मिलाए गए दूध का आयतन = 100 − 40 = 60 इकाइयाँ

⇒ कंटेनर 2 में पानी का आयतन = 100 का 50% = 50 इकाइयाँ

⇒ कंटेनर 2 में मिलाए गए दूध का आयतन = 100 − 50 = 50 इकाइयाँ

⇒ अंतिम मिश्रण में दूध का कुल आयतन = 60 + 50 = 110 इकाइयाँ

⇒ अंतिम मिश्रण में दूध का अंश = 110 ÷ 200

⇒ अंश = 11 ÷ 20 = 0.55

**∴ सही उत्तर 0.55 (या 55%) है।**

**Additional Information**

Mixtures & Alligations

जब दो मात्राओं को मिलाया जाता है, तो उनके आयतन का अनुपात उनमें मौजूद किसी भी सांद्रता के भारित औसत को सीधे निर्धारित करता है।

Weighted Average Formula

अंतिम सांद्रता = (C1V1 + C2V2) ÷ (V1 + V2), जहाँ C सांद्रता है और V आयतन है।

Successive Replacement

यदि किसी मिश्रण का एक अंश निकाल दिया जाता है और उसे पुनरावृत्ति से एक शुद्ध घटक से बदल दिया जाता है, तो शेष मूल घटक की गणना Final = Initial × (1 − Removed/Total)n के रूप में की जाती है।

questions.questionText: A stationery shop ordered 6 dozen red pens and some additional dozen blue pens. The price of the red pens per dozen was three times that of the blue ones. When the order was delivered, it was found that the number of dozens of the two colours had been interchanged. This increased the bill by 40%. Find the ratio of the number of dozens of red pens to the number of dozens of blue pens in the original order.
questions.questionTextHi: एक स्टेशनरी की दुकान ने 6 दर्जन लाल पेन और कुछ अतिरिक्त दर्जन नीले पेन का ऑर्डर दिया है। लाल पेनों का मूल्य, प्रति दर्जन नीले पेनों के मूल्य से तीन गुना था। ऑर्डर की डिलीवरी होने पर पता चला कि दोनों रंगों के पेनों की संख्या आपस में बदल गई थी। इससे बिल में 40% की वृद्धि हो जाती है। मूल ऑर्डर में लाल पेनों की संख्या और नीले पेनों की संख्या का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Assume the price of Blue pens = 1 unit, Red pens = 3 units, and let Blue pens ordered = B dozens.

Original Bill = (6 × 3) + (B × 1) = 18 + B

Interchanged Bill = (B × 3) + (6 × 1) = 3B + 6

The new bill is 40% more, meaning it is 1.4 times the original bill.

⇒ 3B + 6 = 1.4 × (18 + B) ⇒ 1.6B = 19.2 ⇒ B = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 1:2.**

**Alternate Method**

Original Bill

Red : 6 × 3 = 18
Blue : B × 1 = B

Total = 18 + B

New Bill

Red : B × 3 = 3B
Blue : 6 × 1 = 6

Total = 3B + 6

+ 40% Increase

**Given:**

Number of red pens originally ordered = 6 dozens.

Let the number of blue pens originally ordered be B dozens.

Let the price of 1 dozen blue pens be x. Then, the price of 1 dozen red pens = 3x.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Original Bill = (6 × 3x) + (B × x) = 18x + Bx = x(18 + B)

⇒ When the quantities of the two colours are interchanged, Red = B dozens and Blue = 6 dozens.

⇒ New Bill = (B × 3x) + (6 × x) = 3Bx + 6x = x(3B + 6)

⇒ According to the problem, the new bill is 40% more than the original bill.

⇒ New Bill = Original Bill + 40% of Original Bill

⇒ x(3B + 6) = x(18 + B) × 1.4

⇒ Since price x is a positive value, we can divide both sides by x:

⇒ 3B + 6 = 1.4 × (18 + B)

⇒ 3B + 6 = 25.2 + 1.4B

⇒ 3B − 1.4B = 25.2 − 6

⇒ 1.6B = 19.2

⇒ B = 19.2 ÷ 1.6 = 12

⇒ The original order had 6 dozens of red pens and 12 dozens of blue pens.

⇒ Required Ratio = Red pens : Blue pens = 6 : 12 = 1 : 2.

**∴ The correct answer is 1:2.**

**Additional Information**

Percentage Increase Formula

If a value is increased by p%, the final value can directly be computed as Original Value × (1 + p/100).

Total Value Relationship

Total value of any item is given by Quantity × Unit Price. Any changes in quantities or unit prices directly impact the proportionate bill linearly.

Cross-Multiplication in Equations

To simplify decimal coefficients quickly, you can multiply the entire equation by a power of 10. For instance, 1.6B = 19.2 transforms immediately into 16B = 192.
questions.explanationHi:
Shortcut Trick
नीले पेनों की कीमत = 1 इकाई, लाल पेनों की कीमत = 3 इकाई और आर्डर किए गए नीले पेन = B दर्जन मान लीजिये।

मूल बिल = (6 x 3) + (B x 1) = 18 + B

आपसी बदला हुआ बिल = (B x 3) + (6 x 1) = 3B + 6

नया बिल 40% अधिक है, जिसका अर्थ है कि यह मूल बिल का 1.4 गुना है।

⇒ 3B + 6 = 1.4 x (18 + B) ⇒ 1.6B = 19.2 ⇒ B = 12

**∴ सही उत्तर 1:2 है।**

**Alternate Method**

  
  
  Original Bill
  
  Red : 6 x 3 = 18
  Blue : B x 1 = B
  
  Total = 18 + B

  
  
  New Bill
  
  Red : B x 3 = 3B
  Blue : 6 x 1 = 6
  
  Total = 3B + 6

  
  
  
  + 40% Increase

**दिया गया है:**

मूल रूप से आर्डर किए गए लाल पेन की संख्या = 6 दर्जन।

मान लीजिये कि मूल रूप से आर्डर किए गए नीले पेन की संख्या B दर्जन है।

मान लीजिये कि 1 दर्जन नीले पेन की कीमत x है। तो, 1 दर्जन लाल पेन की कीमत = 3x।

**गणना:**

⇒ मूल बिल = (6 x 3x) + (B x x) = 18x + Bx = x(18 + B)

⇒ जब दोनों रंगों की मात्राओं को आपस में बदल दिया जाता है, लाल = B दर्जन और नीला = 6 दर्जन।

⇒ नया बिल = (B x 3x) + (6 x x) = 3Bx + 6x = x(3B + 6)

⇒ प्रश्न के अनुसार, नया बिल मूल बिल से 40% अधिक है।

⇒ नया बिल = मूल बिल + मूल बिल का 40%

⇒ x(3B + 6) = x(18 + B) x 1.4

⇒ चूंकि कीमत x एक धनात्मक मान है, इसलिए हम दोनों पक्षों को x से विभाजित कर सकते हैं:

⇒ 3B + 6 = 1.4 x (18 + B)

⇒ 3B + 6 = 25.2 + 1.4B

⇒ 3B − 1.4B = 25.2 − 6

⇒ 1.6B = 19.2

⇒ B = 19.2 ÷ 1.6 = 12

⇒ मूल आर्डर में 6 दर्जन लाल पेन और 12 दर्जन नीले पेन थे।

⇒ आवश्यक अनुपात = लाल पेन : नीले पेन = 6 : 12 = 1 : 2।

**∴ सही उत्तर 1:2 है।**

**Additional Information**

प्रतिशत वृद्धि सूत्र

यदि किसी मान में p% की वृद्धि होती है, तो अंतिम मान को सीधे मूल मान x (1 + p/100) के रूप में गणना की जा सकती है।

कुल मान संबंध

किसी भी वस्तु का कुल मान मात्रा x इकाई मूल्य द्वारा दिया जाता है। मात्राओं या इकाई मूल्यों में कोई भी परिवर्तन बिल को समानुपातिक रूप से रैखिक रूप से प्रभावित करता है।

समीकरणों में क्रॉस-गुणा

दशमलव गुणांकों को शीघ्रता से सरल बनाने के लिए, आप पूरे समीकरण को 10 की घात से गुणा कर सकते हैं। उदाहरण के लिए, 1.6B = 19.2 तुरंत 16B = 192 में बदल जाता है।

questions.questionText: A flower vendor bought 200 flowers for ₹800. 20 flowers withered and became unsellable. At what price per flower should he sell the remaining flowers to earn a profit of 30% on his total cost?
questions.questionTextHi: एक फूल विक्रेता  ₹800 में 200 फूल खरीदता है। 20 फूल मुरझा जाते हैं और बिकने लायक नहीं रहते हैं। उसे शेष फूलों को प्रति फूल किस मूल्य पर बेचना चाहिए ताकि उसे कुल लागत पर 30% का लाभ हो जाए?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Total Selling Price required for a 30% profit = 130% of ₹800 = ₹1040.

Total sellable flowers = 200 − 20 = 180 flowers.

Selling Price per flower = 1040 ÷ 180 = 52 ÷ 9 ≈ ₹5.78.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5.78.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Total cost price of 200 flowers = ₹800

Number of withered flowers = 20

Desired profit percentage = 30%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100

SP per unit = Total SP ÷ Total units available for sale

CP = ₹800
(200 flowers)

+30% Profit

Total SP = ₹1040
(130% of CP)

÷ 180 flowers

(200 − 20 withered)

SP / flower = ₹5.78

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Selling Price = 800 × (100 + 30) ÷ 100

⇒ Total Selling Price = 800 × 130 ÷ 100 = ₹1040

⇒ Number of flowers available to sell = 200 − 20 = 180

⇒ Selling Price per flower = Total Selling Price ÷ 180

⇒ Selling Price per flower = 1040 ÷ 180

⇒ Selling Price per flower = 52 ÷ 9

⇒ Selling Price per flower = 5.777... ≈ ₹5.78

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5.78.**

**Additional Information**

Profit and Loss Percentage

Profit% or Loss% is strictly calculated based on the Total Cost Price (CP) of the initial quantity bought, unless stated otherwise. Formula: Profit% = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100.

Effective Cost Recovery

When a fraction of goods gets damaged or lost, the desired revenue (Total SP) must be fully recovered by selling only the remaining intact goods. This inherently increases the required Selling Price per unit.

Marked Price and Discount

If a vendor wants to offer discounts while maintaining a fixed profit rate, the Marked Price must be calculated above this calculated Selling Price (SP). Selling Price = Marked Price − Discount.
questions.explanationHi:
Shortcut Trick
30% लाभ के लिए आवश्यक कुल विक्रय मूल्य = ₹800 का 130% = ₹1040।

बिकने योग्य कुल फूल = 200 − 20 = 180 फूल।

प्रति फूल विक्रय मूल्य = 1040 ÷ 180 = 52 ÷ 9 ≈ ₹5.78।

**∴ सही उत्तर ₹5.78 है।**

**Alternate Method**

**दिया गया है:**

200 फूलों का कुल क्रय मूल्य = ₹800

सूखे फूलों की संख्या = 20

वांछित लाभ प्रतिशत = 30%

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

विक्रय मूल्य (SP) = CP x (100 + लाभ%) ÷ 100

प्रति इकाई SP = कुल SP ÷ बिक्री के लिए उपलब्ध कुल इकाइयाँ

  
    
      
    
    
      
    
  

  
  CP = ₹800
  (200 फूल)
  
  
  +30% लाभ

  
  कुल SP = ₹1040
  (CP का 130%)

  
  ÷ 180 फूल
  
  (200 − 20 सूखे हुए)
  

  
  SP / फूल = ₹5.78

**गणना:**

⇒ कुल विक्रय मूल्य = 800 x (100 + 30) ÷ 100

⇒ कुल विक्रय मूल्य = 800 x 130 ÷ 100 = ₹1040

⇒ बिक्री के लिए उपलब्ध फूलों की संख्या = 200 − 20 = 180

⇒ प्रति फूल विक्रय मूल्य = कुल विक्रय मूल्य ÷ 180

⇒ प्रति फूल विक्रय मूल्य = 1040 ÷ 180

⇒ प्रति फूल विक्रय मूल्य = 52 ÷ 9

⇒ प्रति फूल विक्रय मूल्य = 5.777... ≈ ₹5.78

**∴ सही उत्तर ₹5.78 है।**

**Additional Information**

लाभ और हानि प्रतिशत

लाभ% या हानि% की गणना प्रारंभिक मात्रा के कुल क्रय मूल्य (CP) के आधार पर की जाती है, जब तक कि अन्यथा न कहा गया हो। सूत्र: लाभ% = (लाभ ÷ CP) x 100।

प्रभावी लागत वसूली

जब माल का एक अंश क्षतिग्रस्त या खो जाता है, तो वांछित राजस्व (कुल SP) को केवल शेष अक्षत माल बेचकर पूरी तरह से वसूल किया जाना चाहिए। यह प्रति इकाई आवश्यक विक्रय मूल्य को स्वाभाविक रूप से बढ़ाता है।

अंकित मूल्य और छूट

यदि कोई विक्रेता निश्चित लाभ दर बनाए रखते हुए छूट देना चाहता है, तो अंकित मूल्य की गणना इस गणना किए गए विक्रय मूल्य (SP) से अधिक होनी चाहिए। विक्रय मूल्य = अंकित मूल्य − छूट।

questions.questionText: A furniture store sells a dining table for ₹Z, making a 25% profit. During a festive season, they increase the marked price of the same table to ₹1.6Z. They then offer a special discount of 20% on this increased marked price. What will be the percentage profit made by the store during the festive season?
questions.questionTextHi: एक फर्नीचर स्टोर ₹Z में एक डाइनिंग टेबल बेचता है, जिससे उसे 25% का लाभ होता है। त्योहारी सीजन के दौरान, वे उस टेबल का अंकित मूल्य बढ़ाकर ₹1.6Z कर देते हैं। फिर वे इस बढ़े हुए अंकित मूल्य पर 20% की विशेष छूट देते हैं। त्योहारी सीजन के दौरान स्टोर द्वारा अर्जित लाभ प्रतिशत क्या होगा?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Given the initial Selling Price is ₹Z and the profit is 25%, the Cost Price (CP) = Z ÷ 1.25 = 0.8Z.

During the festive season, the new Marked Price is ₹1.6Z.

With a 20% discount on the Marked Price, the new SP = 1.6Z × (1 − 0.20) = 1.28Z.

Profit amount = New SP − CP = 1.28Z − 0.8Z = 0.48Z.

Percentage profit (as a fraction) = 0.48Z ÷ 0.8Z = 0.6.

**∴ The correct answer is 60% (0.6).**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Initial Selling Price = ₹Z

Initial Profit = 25%

New Marked Price (MP) = ₹1.6Z

Festive Discount = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = SP ÷ (1 + Profit/100)

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − Discount/100)

Percentage Profit = [(SP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100

CP = 0.8Z

SP = 1.28Z

MP = 1.6Z

−20% Discount

Profit = +0.48Z

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, calculate the original Cost Price (CP):

⇒ CP × (1 + 0.25) = Z

⇒ 1.25 × CP = Z

⇒ CP = Z ÷ 1.25 = 0.8Z

⇒ Next, calculate the new Selling Price after applying the 20% discount on the new MP:

⇒ New SP = 1.6Z × (1 − 0.20)

⇒ New SP = 1.6Z × 0.80 = 1.28Z

⇒ Calculate the profit earned during the festive season:

⇒ Profit = New SP − CP = 1.28Z − 0.8Z = 0.48Z

⇒ Calculate the profit fraction / percentage:

⇒ Profit fraction = Profit ÷ CP = 0.48Z ÷ 0.8Z = 0.6

⇒ This translates to exactly 60% profit.

**∴ The correct answer is 60% (0.6).**

**Additional Information**

Marked Price and Discount

A discount is strictly calculated on the Marked Price (MP), not the Cost Price. The Selling Price is derived directly by deducting the discount: SP = MP × (1 − Discount%).

Cost Price from Profit Percentage

When the final Selling Price and Profit% are provided, the Cost Price can be efficiently found using the formula: CP = SP × [100 ÷ (100 + Profit%)].

Successive Price Changes

When an article's price is marked up and then followed by a discount, a chain calculation or a successsive percentage formula [a + b + (a × b ÷ 100)] can be used to track the overall profit or loss.

questions.questionText: A solution consists acid and water in the ratio 5:3. If 4 litres of water is added, the new ratio becomes 5:4. What is the original quantity of acid in the solution?
questions.questionTextHi: एक विलयन में अम्ल और पानी का अनुपात 5:3 है। यदि इसमें 4 लीटर पानी मिलाया जाए, तो नया अनुपात 5:4 हो जाता है। विलयन में अम्ल की मूल मात्रा क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Initial Ratio (Acid : Water) = 5 : 3

Final Ratio (Acid : Water) = 5 : 4

Since only water is added, the ratio of acid (5 parts) correctly remains unchanged.

Increase in water ratio = 4 − 3 = 1 part.

1 part = 4 litres ⇒ Original Acid = 5 parts = 5 × 4 = 20 litres.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 litres.**

**Alternate Method**

Initial
Acid = 5u
Water = 3u

Final
Acid = 5u
Water = 4u

+ 4 L Water

Water Change: 4u − 3u = 1u = 4 Litres
Original Acid: 5u = 5 × 4 = 20 Litres

**Given:**

Initial ratio of acid to water = 5 : 3

Water added = 4 litres

New ratio of acid to water = 5 : 4

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let initial acid = 5x and initial water = 3x.

⇒ After adding 4 litres of water, new quantity of water = 3x + 4.

⇒ New ratio = 5x / (3x + 4) = 5 / 4

⇒ 20x = 15x + 20

⇒ 20x − 15x = 20

⇒ 5x = 20 ⇒ x = 4

⇒ Original quantity of acid = 5x = 5 × 4 = 20 litres.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 litres.**

**Additional Information**

Constant Component Concept

When one substance is added to a mixture, the quantity of the other substance remains strictly constant. Equating the ratio parts of the undisturbed component simplifies calculations directly without full equations.

Cross-Multiplication Method

If the initial ratio is a:b and final ratio becomes c:d after adding x and y respectively, the relation is: (a × d) − (b × c) = (y × c) − (x × d). Here, y = 4 and x = 0.

Replacement in Mixtures

When a portion of a mixture is withdrawn without adding anything, the ratio of its components remains identical to the original mixture. The ratio alters only upon adding a new quantity.
questions.explanationHi:
Shortcut Trick
प्रारंभिक अनुपात (अम्ल : पानी) = 5 : 3

अंतिम अनुपात (अम्ल : पानी) = 5 : 4

चूंकि केवल पानी मिलाया जाता है, अम्ल का अनुपात (5 भाग) अपरिवर्तित रहता है।

पानी के अनुपात में वृद्धि = 4 − 3 = 1 भाग।

1 भाग = 4 लीटर ⇒ प्रारंभिक अम्ल = 5 भाग = 5 x 4 = 20 लीटर।

**∴ सही उत्तर 20 लीटर है।**

**Alternate Method**

  Water = 4u

  
  + 4 L Water

  Water Change: 4u − 3u = 1u = 4 Litres
  Original Acid: 5u = 5 x 4 = 20 Litres

**दिया गया है:**

अम्ल और पानी का प्रारंभिक अनुपात = 5 : 3

मिलाया गया पानी = 4 लीटर

अम्ल और पानी का नया अनुपात = 5 : 4

**गणना:**

⇒ माना प्रारंभिक अम्ल = 5x और प्रारंभिक पानी = 3x।

⇒ 4 लीटर पानी मिलाने के बाद, पानी की नई मात्रा = 3x + 4।

⇒ नया अनुपात = 5x / (3x + 4) = 5 / 4

⇒ 20x = 15x + 20

⇒ 20x − 15x = 20

⇒ 5x = 20 ⇒ x = 4

⇒ अम्ल की प्रारंभिक मात्रा = 5x = 5 x 4 = 20 लीटर।

**∴ सही उत्तर 20 लीटर है।**

**Additional Information**

Constant Component Concept

जब किसी मिश्रण में एक पदार्थ मिलाया जाता है, तो दूसरे पदार्थ की मात्रा पूर्णतः स्थिर रहती है। अविकसित घटक के अनुपात भागों को बराबर करने से पूर्ण समीकरणों के बिना सीधे गणना सरल हो जाती है।

Cross-Multiplication Method

यदि प्रारंभिक अनुपात a:b है और क्रमशः x और y जोड़ने के बाद अंतिम अनुपात c:d हो जाता है, तो संबंध है: (a x d) − (b x c) = (y x c) − (x x d)। यहाँ, y = 4 और x = 0 है।

Replacement in Mixtures

जब किसी मिश्रण का एक हिस्सा बिना कुछ मिलाए निकाला जाता है, तो उसके घटकों का अनुपात मूल मिश्रण के समान रहता है। अनुपात केवल एक नई मात्रा जोड़ने पर बदलता है।

questions.questionText: A alone can complete a job in 12 days and B alone in 18 days. A and B agree to do the work for ₹ 7,200. With C's help they finish it in 5 days. How much should C be paid?
questions.questionTextHi: A अकेले किसी कार्य को 12 दिनों में और B अकेले 18 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। A और B ₹ 7,200 में कार्य करने के लिए सहमत होते हैं। C की मदद से वे इसे 5 दिनों में पूरा कर लेते हैं। C को कितना भुगतान किया जाना चाहिए?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Total work = LCM(12, 18, 5) = 180 units.

Efficiency of A = 180 ÷ 12 = 15, B = 180 ÷ 18 = 10, A+B+C = 180 ÷ 5 = 36.

Efficiency of C = 36 − (15 + 10) = 11.

Wage ratio A : B : C = 15 : 10 : 11.

C's share = (11 ÷ 36) × 7200 = ₹2,200.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,200.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Time taken by A alone = 12 days

Time taken by B alone = 18 days

Time taken by A, B, and C together = 5 days

Total wages = ₹ 7,200

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = LCM of time taken

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

Wages are distributed in the ratio of efficiencies when workers work for the same total time.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total efficiency of A, B, and C = 36 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of C = Total efficiency − (Efficiency of A + Efficiency of B)

⇒ Efficiency of C = 36 − (15 + 10) = 11 units/day

⇒ Since they worked together for all 5 days, wages are shared directly in the ratio of their individual efficiencies.

⇒ Ratio of wages A : B : C = 15 : 10 : 11

⇒ Total ratio parts = 15 + 10 + 11 = 36 parts

⇒ 36 parts = ₹ 7,200

⇒ 1 part = 7200 ÷ 36 = ₹ 200

⇒ C's share = 11 parts = 11 × 200 = ₹ 2,200

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,200.**

**Additional Information**

Work and Wages

Wages are strictly proportional to the actual amount of work done by each individual. If workers work together for the same duration, their wages are distributed directly in the ratio of their daily efficiencies.

Different Working Days

If workers work for different numbers of days, their respective wage shares are calculated by multiplying their efficiency with the number of days they worked: Share = Efficiency × Days Worked.

Pipes and Cisterns

This concept mirrors Time and Work exactly. Filling pipes have a positive efficiency (doing work), while emptying pipes or leaks have a negative efficiency (undoing work).

जब श्रमिक समान कुल समय के लिए कार्य करते हैं तो मजदूरी को दक्षता के अनुपात में वितरित किया जाता है।

**Additional Information**

Work and Wages

मजदूरी प्रत्येक व्यक्ति द्वारा किए गए कार्य की वास्तविक मात्रा के समानुपाती होती है। यदि श्रमिक समान अवधि के लिए एक साथ कार्य करते हैं, तो उनकी मजदूरी उनकी दैनिक दक्षता के अनुपात में सीधे वितरित की जाती है।

Different Working Days

Pipes and Cisterns

यह अवधारणा समय और कार्य को बिल्कुल दर्शाती है। भरने वाले पाइपों में सकारात्मक दक्षता होती है (कार्य करना), जबकि खाली करने वाले पाइपों या रिसाव में नकारात्मक दक्षता होती है (कार्य को रद्द करना)।

questions.questionText: A tank has a mixture of solutions A, B, and C in the respective ratio of 7:8:5. 40 litres of this mixture is drained out, and subsequently, 15 litres of solution A and 5 litres of solution C are added to the tank. If the resultant quantity of solution A is 25 litres less than the resultant quantity of solution B, what was the initial quantity of mixture in the tank (in litres)?
questions.questionTextHi: एक टंकी में 7:8:5 के अनुपात में विलयन A, B और C का मिश्रण है। इस मिश्रण का 40 लीटर निकाल दिया जाता है और बाद में, टंकी में 15 लीटर विलयन A और 5 लीटर विलयन C डाला जाता है। यदि विलयन A की परिणामी मात्रा, विलयन B की परिणामी मात्रा से 25 लीटर कम है, तो टंकी में मिश्रण की प्रारंभिक मात्रा (लीटर में) क्या थी?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick

Final quantity of A = 7k + 15 L and Final quantity of B = 8k.

Given, Final B − Final A = 25 ⇒ 8k − (7k + 15) = 25 ⇒ k = 40.

Total remaining mixture = 20 × 40 = 800 L.

Initial mixture = 800 L + 40 L (drained) = 840 L.

**∴ The correct answer is 840 litres.**

questions.questionText: The ratio of the time taken by A and B to complete a task is 3 : 2. If B can complete the task alone in 18 hours, how many hours will they take to complete the task if they work together?

questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Time ratio of A : B = 3 : 2, so efficiency ratio of A : B = 2 : 3.

Total work = Efficiency of B × Time taken by B = 3 × 18 = 54 units.

Combined efficiency of A and B = 2 + 3 = 5 units/hour.

Time taken together = Total work ÷ Combined efficiency = 54 ÷ 5 = 10.8 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 10.8 hours.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Ratio of time taken by A and B = 3 : 2

Time taken by B = 18 hours

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the time taken by A be 3x and by B be 2x.

⇒ 2x = 18 hours

⇒ x = 9 hours

⇒ Time taken by A = 3 × 9 = 27 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 10.8 hours.**

**Additional Information**

Time & Efficiency Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken. If the ratio of time taken by A and B is x : y, then the ratio of their efficiencies is y : x.

Work and Wages

Wages are generally distributed in the ratio of the total work done by each individual. If workers work for the same number of days, the wages are distributed directly in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Pipes & Cisterns

The concept of time and work directly applies to pipes. Inlet pipes have positive efficiency (filling work) while outlet pipes or leaks have negative efficiency (emptying work).

questions.questionText: Three friends, X, Y, and Z, are cycling on a circular track with a circumference of 2 km. They all start from the same point at 9:00 a.m. and travel in the same direction with speeds of 10 km/h, 12 km/h, and 15 km/h respectively. How many times will all three of them meet at the starting point if they continue cycling until 1:00 p.m.?
questions.questionTextHi: तीन मित्र, X, Y और Z, 2 किमी परिधि वाले एक वृत्ताकार ट्रैक पर साइकिल चला रहे हैं। वे सभी सुबह 9:00 बजे एक ही बिंदु से चलना प्रारंभ करते हैं और क्रमशः 10 किमी/घंटा, 12 किमी/घंटा और 15 किमी/घंटा की चाल से एक ही दिशा में यात्रा करते हैं। यदि वे दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक साइकिल चलाना जारी रखते हैं, तो वे तीनों कितनी बार प्रारंभिक बिंदु पर मिलेंगे?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Time taken for one round = Distance ÷ Speed.

Tx = 2/10 = 1/5 h, Ty = 2/12 = 1/6 h, Tz = 2/15 h.

Time to meet at start = LCM(1/5, 1/6, 2/15) = 2/1 = 2 hours.

Total time from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. = 4 hours.

Number of meetings = Total time ÷ Meeting interval = 4 ÷ 2 = 2 times.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 times.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Circumference of the track (D) = 2 km

Speeds: X = 10 km/h, Y = 12 km/h, Z = 15 km/h

Cycling duration = 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. = 4 hours

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Meeting time at start point = LCM of individual times taken for one round

LCM of fractions = LCM of Numerators ÷ HCF of Denominators

Start Point
D = 2 km

Speeds:
X = 10 km/h
Y = 12 km/h
Z = 15 km/h

Time to meet = LCM of individual times

**Calculations:**

⇒ Tx = 2 ÷ 10 = 1/5 h

⇒ Ty = 2 ÷ 12 = 1/6 h

⇒ Tz = 2 ÷ 15 = 2/15 h

⇒ Meeting time = LCM(1/5, 1/6, 2/15)

⇒ LCM of numerators (1, 1, 2) = 2

⇒ HCF of denominators (5, 6, 15) = 1

⇒ LCM(1/5, 1/6, 2/15) = 2 ÷ 1 = 2 hours

⇒ They all meet at the starting point every 2 hours.

⇒ Total duration from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. = 4 hours.

⇒ Number of meetings = 4 ÷ 2 = 2 times

**∴ The correct answer is 2 times.**

**Additional Information**

Meeting at the Starting Point

When multiple runners or objects move around a circular path starting at the same time, the time required for all of them to meet at the starting point simultaneously is always the LCM of the times taken by each to complete exactly one round.

First Meeting on a Circular Track

If two bodies move in the same direction, they will meet for the very first time anywhere on the track after a time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed (Difference of their speeds). If moving in opposite directions, relative speed is the sum of their speeds.

LCM & HCF of Fractions

LCM of fractions = LCM of Numerators ÷ HCF of Denominators.
HCF of fractions = HCF of Numerators ÷ LCM of Denominators.

questions.explanation:

Area of a circular path = π × w × (2r + w)

Where w = 3 m (width of path) and r = 8 m (inner radius)

Area = π × 3 × (2 × 8 + 3) = π × 3 × 19

Area = 57π ≈ 57 × 3.14 ≈ 179 m2

**∴ The correct answer is 179 m2.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Inner radius of the park (r) = 8 m

Width of the path (w) = 3 m

Outer radius of the park with path (R) = 8 m + 3 m = 11 m

Area of circular path = Area of outer circle − Area of inner circle

Area = πR2 − πr2 = π(R2 − r2)

⇒ Area = π × (121 − 64)

⇒ Area = 57π

The total region enclosed by a circle is given by Area = πr2, where r is the radius.

For a circular path of width w around a circle of radius r, the area is calculated as π(R2 − r2) or πw(2r + w), where the outer radius R = r + w.

त्रिज्या r के एक वृत्त के चारों ओर चौड़ाई w के एक वृत्ताकार पथ के लिए, क्षेत्रफल की गणना π(R2 − r2) या πw(2r + w) के रूप में की जाती है, जहाँ बाहरी त्रिज्या R = r + w है।

परिधि

एक वृत्त की परिधि या बाहरी सीमा की लंबाई C = 2πr के रूप में गणना की जाती है।

questions.questionText: Find the slope of the line perpendicular to \(y = \frac{1}{4}x + 7\)
questions.questionTextHi: \(y = \frac{1}{4}x + 7\) पर लंबवत रेखा की प्रवणता ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
The slope of the given line in the form y = mx + c is m = 1/4.

The slope of a perpendicular line is always the negative reciprocal of the original line's slope.

Perpendicular slope = −1 ÷ (1/4) = −4.

**∴ The correct answer is -4.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Equation of the line: y = 1/4x + 7

**Formula Used:**

For two perpendicular lines with slopes m1 and m2: m1 × m2 = −1

y = 1/4x + 7
m₁ = 1/4

Perpendicular Line
m₂ = -4

**Calculations:**

⇒ The given line is structured in the standard form y = mx + c, where m represents the slope of the line.

⇒ By comparing the equations directly, the slope of the given line (m1) = 1/4

⇒ Let the slope of the required perpendicular line be defined as m2.

⇒ Since the properties of perpendicular lines state that their product is −1, we have m1 × m2 = −1

⇒ (1/4) × m2 = −1

⇒ m2 = −1 × 4

⇒ m2 = −4

**∴ The correct answer is -4.**

**Additional Information**

Slope-Intercept Form

The equation of a straight line is typically expressed as y = mx + c, where m is the slope defining the steepness and c is the y-intercept.

Parallel Lines

If two straight lines are distinctly parallel to each other, their slopes will always be exactly equal (m1 = m2).

Perpendicular Lines

When two non-vertical straight lines intersect perfectly at a right angle, the resulting product of their slopes evaluates to −1 (m1 × m2 = −1).

questions.questionText: Convert 2.5 radians to degrees.
questions.questionTextHi: 2.5 रेडियन को डिग्री में परिवर्तित कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
We know the standard conversion where 1 radian is approximately equal to 57.3°.

To convert 2.5 radians to degrees, we simply multiply the value by 57.3°.

⇒ 2.5 × 57.3° = 143.25°

Looking at the given options, the closest exact value is 143.24°.

**∴ The correct answer is 143.24°.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Angle = 2.5 radians

**Formula Used:**

Angle in Degrees = Angle in Radians × (180° ÷ π)

2.5 rad
143.24°

**Calculation:**

⇒ Angle in Degrees = 2.5 × (180° ÷ π)

⇒ Angle in Degrees = 450° ÷ π

Using the precise value of π ≈ 3.14159:

⇒ Angle in Degrees = 450° ÷ 3.14159

⇒ Angle in Degrees ≈ 143.2395°

⇒ Rounding off to two decimal places, we get 143.24°.

**∴ The correct answer is 143.24°.**

**Additional Information**

Radian to Degree Conversion

To convert any given angle from radians to degrees, multiply the radian value by 180° ÷ π.

Degree to Radian Conversion

To convert an angle from degrees back to radians, multiply the degree value by π ÷ 180°.

Standard Conversions

Some common unit circle angles include: π radians = 180°, π ÷ 2 radians = 90°, and π ÷ 4 radians = 45°.

questions.questionText: A sector of a circle having a radius of 10 cm and has a central angle of \( \frac{\pi}{6}\) radians. What is the area of the sector?
questions.questionTextHi: एक वृत्त का त्रिज्यखंड जिसकी त्रिज्या 10 सेमी है और जिसका केंद्रीय कोण \( \frac{\pi}{6}\) रेडियन है। त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Direct formula for the area of a sector in radians: Area = ½ × r2 × θ

Substitute the given values: r = 10 cm and θ = π/6.

Area = ½ × (10)2 × (π/6) = ½ × 100 × π/6 = 25π / 3

Using π ≈ 3.14, Area = (25 × 3.14) ÷ 3 = 78.5 ÷ 3 ≈ 26.17 cm2.

**∴ The correct answer is 26.17 cm2.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Radius of the sector (r) = 10 cm

Central angle (θ) = π/6 radians

Perimeter of a Sector

The total perimeter bounds the sector, including the curved arc length and the two straight radii. It is found using Perimeter = s + 2r.

questions.questionText: If tan A = cot(2A - 30°), then what is the value of A?
questions.questionTextHi: यदि tan A = cot(2A - 30°) है, तो A का मान क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
If tan x = cot y, then their angles are complementary: x + y = 90°

Given: tan A = cot(2A − 30°)

⇒ A + (2A − 30°) = 90°

⇒ 3A = 120°

⇒ A = 40°

**∴ The correct answer is 40°.**

**Alternate Method**

**Formula Used:**

cot θ = tan(90° − θ)

⇒ A = 90° − (2A − 30°)

⇒ A = 90° − 2A + 30°

questions.questionText: In similar triangles, the ratio of corresponding altitudes is 2:5. What is the ratio of their areas?
questions.questionTextHi: समरूप त्रिभुजों में, संगत शीर्षलंबों का अनुपात 2:5 है। उनके क्षेत्रफलों का अनुपात क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
For similar triangles, the ratio of their areas equals the square of the ratio of their corresponding altitudes.

Ratio of areas = (Ratio of altitudes)2

⇒ Area Ratio = (2 ÷ 5)2 = 4 : 25

**∴ The correct answer is 4:25.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Ratio of corresponding altitudes of two similar triangles (h1 : h2) = 2 : 5

**Formula Used:**

Area of Δ1 ÷ Area of Δ2 = (h1 ÷ h2)2

h1 = 2
Area = A1

h2 = 5
Area = A2

A1 : A2 = h1² : h2²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of Δ1 ÷ Area of Δ2 = (2 ÷ 5)2

⇒ Area of Δ1 ÷ Area of Δ2 = 4 ÷ 25

⇒ Ratio of their areas = 4 : 25

**∴ The correct answer is 4:25.**

**Additional Information**

Area of Similar Triangles

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is precisely equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides, altitudes, or medians.

Perimeter of Similar Triangles

The ratio of the perimeters of two similar triangles is directly equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides, altitudes, or medians.

Inradius & Circumradius Ratio

For two similar triangles, the ratio of their corresponding inradii or circumradii follows the exact same ratio as their corresponding sides.
questions.explanationHi:
Shortcut Trick
समरूप त्रिभुजों के लिए, उनके क्षेत्रफलों का अनुपात उनकी संगत ऊंचाइयों के अनुपात के वर्ग के बराबर होता है।

क्षेत्रफलों का अनुपात = (ऊंचाइयों का अनुपात)2

⇒ क्षेत्रफल अनुपात = (2 ÷ 5)2 = 4 : 25

**∴ सही उत्तर 4:25 है।**

**Alternate Method**

**दिया गया है:**

दो समरूप त्रिभुजों की संगत ऊंचाइयों का अनुपात (h1 : h2) = 2 : 5

  h1 = 2
  Area = A1
  
  
  
  
  h2 = 5
  Area = A2

  A1 : A2 = h1² : h2²

**गणना:**

⇒ Δ1 का क्षेत्रफल ÷ Δ2 का क्षेत्रफल = (2 ÷ 5)2

⇒ Δ1 का क्षेत्रफल ÷ Δ2 का क्षेत्रफल = 4 ÷ 25

⇒ उनके क्षेत्रफलों का अनुपात = 4 : 25

**∴ सही उत्तर 4:25 है।**

**Additional Information**

समरूप त्रिभुजों का क्षेत्रफल

दो समरूप त्रिभुजों के क्षेत्रफलों का अनुपात उनकी संगत भुजाओं, ऊंचाइयों या माध्यिकाओं के अनुपात के वर्ग के ठीक बराबर होता है।

questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
Directly apply the algebraic identity: (x + y)2 + (x − y)2 = 2(x2 + y2)

Here, replacing x with a and y with 1:

⇒ (a + 1)2 + (a − 1)2 = 2(a2 + 12)

Substitute a = √5 ⇒ a2 = 5.

⇒ 2(5 + 1) = 2 × 6 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

a = √5

**Formula Used:**

(x + y)2 = x2 + 2xy + y2

(x − y)2 = x2 − 2xy + y2

**Calculation:**

⇒ (a + 1)2 = a2 + 2a + 1

⇒ (a − 1)2 = a2 − 2a + 1

Adding both expanded expressions together:

⇒ (a2 + 2a + 1) + (a2 − 2a + 1)

⇒ 2a2 + 2

Substitute the given value a = √5:

⇒ 2(√5)2 + 2

⇒ 2 × 5 + 2

⇒ 10 + 2 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

**Additional Information**

Important Algebraic Identities

Another useful identity for subtraction is: (a + b)2 − (a − b)2 = 4ab.

Difference of Squares

The product of sum and difference is: a2 − b2 = (a − b)(a + b).

Square Root Properties

The square of a square root returns the original non-negative value: (√x)2 = x. Also, roots can be multiplied directly: √x × √y = √(xy).

यहाँ, x को a से और y को 1 से प्रतिस्थापित करने पर:

⇒ (a + 1)2 + (a − 1)2 = 2(a2 + 12)

**∴ सही उत्तर 12 है।**

**Alternate Method**

a = √5

(x + y)2 = x2 + 2xy + y2

**गणना:**

⇒ (a − 1)2 = a2 − 2a + 1

दोनों विस्तृत व्यंजकों को एक साथ जोड़ने पर:

⇒ (a2 + 2a + 1) + (a2 − 2a + 1)

⇒ 2a2 + 2

दिए गए मान a = √5 को प्रतिस्थापित करें:

⇒ 2(√5)2 + 2

⇒ 2 x 5 + 2

⇒ 10 + 2 = 12

**∴ सही उत्तर 12 है।**

**Additional Information**

Important Algebraic Identities

घटाव के लिए एक और उपयोगी सर्वसमिका है: (a + b)2 − (a − b)2 = 4ab।

योग और अंतर का गुणनफल है: a2 − b2 = (a − b)(a + b)।

वर्गमूल का वर्ग मूल गैर-ऋणात्मक मान देता है: (√x)2 = x। साथ ही, मूलों को सीधे गुणा किया जा सकता है: √x x √y = √(xy)।

questions.questionText: Simplify: √50 + √18 - √8
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick

Directly extract perfect squares from the square roots:

⇒ √50 + √18 − √8

⇒ √(25 × 2) + √(9 × 2) − √(4 × 2)

⇒ 5√2 + 3√2 − 2√2 = 6√2

**∴ The correct answer is 6√2.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

Expression: √50 + √18 − √8

**Method Used:**

Prime factorization of the numbers inside the roots to extract terms outside the square root.

**Calculations:**

⇒ √50 = √(2 × 5 × 5) = 5√2

⇒ √18 = √(2 × 3 × 3) = 3√2

⇒ √8 = √(2 × 2 × 2) = 2√2

Substitute these values back into the expression:

⇒ 5√2 + 3√2 − 2√2

Take √2 as common:

⇒ (5 + 3 − 2) × √2

⇒ 6√2

**∴ The correct answer is 6√2.**

**Additional Information**

Similar Surds

Surds which have the same irrational factor are called similar surds. Only similar surds can be added or subtracted. Example: 3√2 and 5√2 are similar surds.

Multiplication and Division of Surds

Unlike addition and subtraction, surds with the same order can be multiplied or divided regardless of their base. √a × √b = √(ab) and √a ÷ √b = √(a/b).

Simplifying Surds

To simplify a square root, find the largest perfect square factor of the number inside the root, and bring its square root outside. Example: √(x2y) = x√y.

questions.questionText: If sin A + cos A = √2 sin A, then what is the value of tanA?
questions.questionTextHi: यदि sin A + cos A = √2 sin A है, तो tanA का मान क्या है ?
questions.explanation:
Shortcut Trick
⇒ sin A + cos A = √2 sin A

⇒ cos A = sin A(√2 − 1) ⇒ cot A = √2 − 1

⇒ tan A = 1 ÷ cot A = 1 ÷ (√2 − 1)

⇒ Rationalizing the denominator gives tan A = √2 + 1

**∴ The correct answer is √2 + 1.**

**Alternate Method**

**Given:**

sin A + cos A = √2 sin A

**Formula Used:**

tan A = sin A ÷ cos A

(a − b)(a + b) = a2 − b2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Divide the entire given equation by cos A:

⇒ (sin A ÷ cos A) + (cos A ÷ cos A) = √2(sin A ÷ cos A)

⇒ tan A + 1 = √2 tan A

⇒ 1 = √2 tan A − tan A

⇒ 1 = tan A(√2 − 1)

⇒ tan A = 1 ÷ (√2 − 1)

⇒ Multiply numerator and denominator by (√2 + 1):

⇒ tan A = (√2 + 1) ÷ [(√2 − 1)(√2 + 1)]

⇒ tan A = (√2 + 1) ÷ [(√2)2 − (1)2]

⇒ tan A = (√2 + 1) ÷ (2 − 1)

⇒ tan A = √2 + 1

**∴ The correct answer is √2 + 1.**

**Additional Information**

Basic Trigonometric Ratios

tan A = sin A ÷ cos A and cot A = cos A ÷ sin A.

Pythagorean Identities

sin2 A + cos2 A = 1 | 1 + tan2 A = sec2 A | 1 + cot2 A = cosec2 A.

Algebraic Rationalization

To rationalize a denominator of the form (a − b), multiply numerator and denominator by its conjugate (a + b) using the identity (a − b)(a + b) = a2 − b2.

questions.questionText:
**Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:**

The investigation's findings, alarming in both scope and content, (1)/ prompted responses not just from the agencies concerned (2)/ but also from the auditors who report they (3)/ were never granted access to critical records. (4)
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Part 3 .

**Key Points**

**The Error:** The error lies in the usage of the subjective pronoun **'they'** at the end of Part 3.
**Grammatical Rule (Pronoun Case):** In English, we use **Subjective Pronouns** (I, he, she, we, they) when the pronoun is the subject of a verb. We use **Objective Pronouns** (me, him, her, us, them) when the pronoun is the object of a verb or preposition.
**Analysis:** In the phrase *"who report they,"* the pronoun **'they'** is intended to be the subject of the clause that follows (*"they were never granted..."*). However, the way the sentence is structured, the reporting act requires a conjunction (**that**) to lead into the next clause, or the pronoun must clearly act as the subject of the subsequent verb.
**Correction:** The sentence should read *"...auditors who report **that they** were never granted..."* or simply ensure the pronoun **'they'** is properly placed as the subject of the passive verb *"were granted"* in Part 4. The current transition in Part 3 is abrupt and grammatically incomplete.

**Additional Information**

**Not just... but also:** This is a correlative conjunction. The sentence correctly uses this pair to link *"from the agencies"* and *"from the auditors."* (Parallelism).
**Concerned:** When placed after a noun (agencies concerned), it means "involved" or "relevant." When placed before (concerned agencies), it often means "worried." Both are grammatically correct depending on meaning.
**Subject-Verb Agreement:** The main subject *"findings"* (plural) correctly agrees with the verb *"prompted"* (past tense).

Correct sentence: *That certain state governments have invoked archaic laws to suppress dissent not only reflects legal opportunism but also undermines the constitutional ethos that such provisions were meant to uphold.*

Correct: He not only sings but also dances.

questions.questionText:
**Change the following from active to passive: **

The jury has delivered a unanimous verdict.

options.text: A unanimous verdict has been delivered by the jury.
A unanimous verdict was being delivered by the jury.
A unanimous verdict had been delivered by the jury.
A unanimous verdict is delivered by the jury.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. A unanimous verdict has been delivered by the jury. .

**Key Points**

To change a sentence from active to passive voice, the subject becomes the receiver of the action, and the object becomes the doer.
The active sentence here is: **The jury has delivered a unanimous verdict.**
In passive voice, the object ("a unanimous verdict") comes first, followed by the verb in the passive form. The subject ("the jury") follows, preceded by "by".
The correct passive construction is: **A unanimous verdict has been delivered by the jury.**

Correct sentence: *A unanimous verdict has been delivered by the jury.*

**Additional Information**

**Active voice:** The subject performs the action expressed by the verb.

**Example:** The chef prepared the meal.

**Passive voice:** The subject receives the action expressed by the verb.

**Example:** The meal was prepared by the chef.

Verb tense in passive voice is formed by using the correct form of "to be" + the past participle of the main verb.

**Homonyms:** Words that are spelled the same and may sound the same but have different meanings.
**Examples:**

**Bat:** Referring to the flying mammal or the equipment used in cricket/baseball.
**Bank:** Referring to a financial institution or the side of a river.

questions.questionText:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:**

The construction is alleged to have been halted due to environmental violations.

options.text: It is alleged that the authorities halted the construction.
The authorities are alleged to have halted the construction.
The violation allegedly halted the construction.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. **The authorities are alleged to have halted the construction.**

**Key Points**

The original sentence is in the **passive voice**, where the subject receives the action.
To convert it to the **active voice**, the focus shifts to the performer of the action (i.e., the authorities).
Among the options provided, Option 3 accurately conveys the meaning of the original sentence in active voice.
Option 3, "The authorities are alleged to have halted the construction," maintains the context of the allegation and specifies who performed the action.

**Additional Information**

**Passive Voice Structure:** Subject + verb (to be) + past participle + additional information.
**Active Voice Structure:** Subject (performer of action) + verb + object + additional information.
In this case, the authorities are the subject performing the action, making Option 3 the most appropriate active voice transformation.

questions.questionText: What major government initiative catalyzed India's digital ecosystem?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Key Points**

The passage identifies the primary driver behind the country's technological shift as a specific government program.
It explicitly states that the transformation was **"spearheaded by government initiatives such as Digital India."**
This program is credited with fueling the massive growth in internet penetration, digital payments, and the delivery of online public services.
While the text mentions other systems like **Aadhaar** and **UPI**, these are presented as pivotal components or results that functioned alongside the broader **Digital India** framework.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence from Text:** *"Spearheaded by government initiatives such as **Digital India**, the country has witnessed an unprecedented surge..."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: BharatNet** – This is a real-world project for rural broadband, but it is **not mentioned** by name in the provided passage.
**Option 2: Digital Bharat** – This is a similar-sounding term, but the passage specifically uses the name **Digital India**.
**Option 4: India Connect** – This term does not appear in the text as a government initiative.

questions.questionText: What role did Aadhaar play in digital growth?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Key Points**

The passage identifies **Aadhaar** as a "pivotal moment" in India's digital transformation journey.
It specifically describes Aadhaar as a **"biometric-based identification system"** designed for a particular purpose.
According to the text, the primary role of this system was that it **"enabled secure and streamlined access to various public services."**
This streamlined access is a core part of how the country expanded its digital ecosystem and improved online governance.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Correct Sentence from Text:** *"A pivotal moment in this journey was the launch of Aadhaar... that **enabled secure and streamlined access to various public services**."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: Promoted telecom infrastructure** – While digital growth relies on infrastructure, the passage does not specifically attribute the promotion of telecom hardware to Aadhaar.
**Option 2: Enabled biometric voting** – This is not mentioned in the text; the passage focuses on "public services" generally.
**Option 3: Offered unified payments** – The passage attributes "real-time, low-cost transactions" and unified payments to the **UPI (Unified Payments Interface)**, not Aadhaar.

questions.questionText: Which factor unexpectedly accelerated India's digital adoption?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Key Points**

The passage describes various planned initiatives (like Aadhaar and UPI), but highlights one specific event that forced a rapid shift in behavior.
It explicitly states that **"the pandemic acted as an unexpected catalyst"** for India's digital transformation.
Because lockdowns required physical distancing, digital services like **telemedicine, online education, and remote work** moved from being optional to "essential."
This event forced both the public and private sectors to quickly "embrace scalable tech solutions," thereby accelerating adoption faster than previously expected.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence from Text:** *"Significantly, the **pandemic acted as an unexpected catalyst**. As lockdowns forced physical distancing, citizens turned to digital alternatives..."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: Demonetisation** – While this historically impacted digital payments in India, it is **not mentioned** in this specific passage.
**Option 2: GST Implementation** – This is a tax reform that is not discussed in the context of digital acceleration within the provided text.
**Option 4: Global recession** – The passage does not link digital adoption to a global economic downturn; it focuses on the health crisis as the driver.

questions.questionText: What is a current challenge in India's digital development?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Key Points**

The passage notes that while India's growth is revolutionary, it faces several "obstacles" and "pressing issues."
It specifically mentions a **"persistent digital divide"** that exists between urban metros and rural villages regarding connectivity speeds.
Furthermore, it highlights that the digital age has brought about significant concerns regarding **"data privacy, cybersecurity, and misinformation."**
**Option 3** correctly combines these two major challenges explicitly stated in the text.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence from Text:** *"However, the digital journey hasn't been without obstacles. A persistent **digital divide** remains... Moreover, concerns around **data privacy**, cybersecurity, and misinformation have emerged as pressing issues..."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: Internet monopoly** – The passage does not discuss the market structure of Internet Service Providers (ISPs) or monopolies.
**Option 2: Mobile phone production** – This is an industrial/manufacturing topic that is not mentioned in the passage.
**Option 4: Excess of investors** – The text does not mention international investment levels as a challenge; it focuses on infrastructure and security.

questions.questionText: What does the passage suggest is key to India's digital future?

options.text: Higher tax rates on digital goods

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Key Points**

The passage concludes by looking toward the future of India's digital trajectory.
It states that the nation is at a "crucial intersection" where specific factors will determine its success.
The author explicitly identifies these factors as **"robust digital policy, inclusive access, and responsible innovation."**
This highlights that bridging the digital divide (inclusive access) and ensuring technology is used ethically (responsible innovation) are the core pillars for future growth.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Correct Sentence from Text:** *"...where robust digital policy, **inclusive access, and responsible innovation** will determine the trajectory of its digital future."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: More mobile apps** – While apps are part of the ecosystem, the passage emphasizes policy and access rather than just the quantity of applications.
**Option 2: Higher tax rates** – The passage does not mention taxation at all.
**Option 3: Stricter censorship laws** – The text mentions "misinformation" as a concern, but it points toward "responsible innovation" and policy rather than censorship as the key to the future.

questions.questionText: Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence: I am confident **to pass the examination.**
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**of passing the examination**'.

**Key Points**

The phrase "**confident of passing**" is the correct grammatical construction.
The preposition "**of**" is used with "confident" to indicate belief or assurance about achieving something.
**Options 1, 2**, and 4 are incorrect as they do not follow the standard grammatical pattern.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Complete Sentence:** *"I am confident **of passing the examination**."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: "in passing the exam"** is incorrect as "confident" is not followed by "in" in standard usage.
**Option 2: "to passing the exam"** is incorrect because "to" does not correctly pair with "confident."
**Option 4: "for passing examination"** is incorrect; "for" is not the correct preposition to use with "confident."

questions.questionText:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

You must **adapt with the situation.**
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**adapt to the situation**'.

**Key Points**

The correct preposition to use with the verb "**adapt**" is "**to**."
The phrase "**adapt to the situation**" means to adjust oneself to the circumstances effectively.
**Option 1** is incorrect because "**to the situation**" alone does not convey the full meaning without the verb "**adapt**."
**Option 2** is incorrect as it lacks a preposition and is grammatically incomplete.
**Option 4** is incorrect because "**by the situation**" conveys a different meaning, implying causation rather than adjustment.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Complete Sentence:** *"You must **adapt to the situation**."*

**Additional Information**

**Option 1: "to the situation"** is incomplete without the verb "**adapt**."
**Option 2: "the situation"** is grammatically incorrect as it omits the necessary preposition.
**Option 4: "by the situation"** is incorrect as it changes the intended meaning of the sentence.
